observation_level: ten paired fresh Chrome roots on one host; no IID claim
pair_sensitivity_scope: descriptive marginal sensitivity only; not necessarily wider; not a gate or multiplicity-adjusted replacement
even_median: arithmetic mean of central two values
candidate_gate: Every dilation: global checks, X duration and X/A ratio relative MAD<=.02, X/A point<=.95, adjusted upper<1, >=8/10 strict wins, both half points<1, all ten leave-one-root-out points<1
panel_gate: Every dilation: adjusted P/Q upper<1, >=8/10 strict wins, P/Q relative MAD<=.02, both half points<1
selection: only Q qualifies=>Q; only P=>P with mechanism unresolved unless panel gate; both=>P only if panel gate otherwise Q; neither=>none
advance_scope: separate production-layout/full-CORE decision, not adoption or run permission
limitations: ten roots may be serially dependent
